description.zh: dsh-skill-shelf 的社区插件市场索引。

description.en: Browse, search and switch every local skill from one panel: Settings → Skill Shelf (General / Workspace / Market / Evolution / Trash), or the 960 px sidebar panel (the sidebar entry can be turned off in settings). Each row shows day / week / total call counts and success rate from an append-only local ledger at ~/.dsh/skill-usage-manager/usage-ledger.jsonl that survives session deletion; the rate is recorded from each call's actual result, and calls with no recorded result show as unknown rather than 0%. The General tab groups by directory, role, invocation or as a flat list; roles come from keyword rules over each skill's name and description, and the view honours the status filter like the others. The per-row model / user invocation switches write back to that skill's SKILL.md frontmatter in place, so the recorded install time is never disturbed. Installs are content-audited first (hidden control characters, pipe-to-shell, credential paths); GitHub sources keep a commit pin, an update check and a restorable trash (expand for the note), and diagnostics locate and repair loading problems. The Evolution tab mines proposals from session history with an occurrence probability, logs every decision to a ledger, and after human review applies them into the owning project workspace. Only ~/.dsh/skills and ~/.agents/skills are writable, and every toggle is a sidecar override, so skill source files never change. Pure local: no model calls; it contacts GitHub and skills.sh only for the checks and installs you start, and turning the plugin off removes the panel, the routes and the system-prompt note.
description.zh: 在一个面板里浏览、搜索、开关本机全部技能：设置 →「技能书架」（通用 / 工作区 / 市场 / 进化 / 回收站），或侧边栏 960px 面板（侧栏入口可在设置里关闭）。每行显示 `~/.dsh/skill-usage-manager/usage-ledger.jsonl` 只追加台账统计的当日 / 本周 / 累计调用次数与成功率（删掉会话也不丢）；成功率按每次调用的实际结果记录，没有结果记录的显示「未知」而不是 0%。通用页可按目录、角色、调用方式或平铺查看，角色由技能名称与描述的关键词规则自动归类，并同样受状态筛选影响。技能行的「模型 / 用户」可调用开关写回该技能 SKILL.md 的 frontmatter，写入用原位覆盖，安装时间不会被改动。装前先过内容审计（隐藏控制字符、管道执行、凭据路径），GitHub 来源带 commit 钉版、更新检查与可恢复回收站（展开可见说明），诊断能定位并修复加载问题。进化页从会话挖掘提案并给出出现概率，每次裁决进台账，经人工审核后可落地到对应项目工作区。只有 `~/.dsh/skills` 与 `~/.agents/skills` 可写，所有开关都只写 sidecar 覆盖，技能源文件不动。纯本地：不调用模型；只有你主动发起的检查与安装才联网 GitHub 与 skills.sh；关掉插件后面板、路由与系统提示说明全部下线。
